run_gpt2_training: run the GPT-2 model training loop with distributed data parallel across multiple GPUs
create_muon_optimizer: create a Muon optimizer instance with configurable learning rate, momentum, and Newton-Schulz backend
build_gpt_model: build a GPT-2 model with configurable vocab size, layers, heads, and embedding dimensions
use_distributed_dataloader: use the DistributedDataLoader to load tokenized data shards across multiple processes for training
apply_rotary_embedding: apply rotary positional embeddings to multihead attention query and key tensors
